assumptions.text: A1. The empty priority folder is taken to mean that no earlier application exists or none has been supplied; the package does not say which.

A2. Whether the August 2026 bench test ([0157]) or anything else was disclosed publicly before filing cannot be judged from the package; that is a novelty and grace-period question for counsel, not a priority question.

open_questions.text: Q1. (Requester or counsel) Is priority to be claimed from any earlier application? If so, place it in intake/priority/ so Prompt 31 can be run; if not, confirm this is a first filing so the priority control can be closed as not applicable.
